notes: Attendance fixes: Dashboard aur Flashy par ab sirf Active employees (92) dikhte hain. Attendance Management ab wahi attendance dikhati hai jo record mein hai — pehle zyada tar Absent nazar ata tha. Full-month chart ab data ek dafa load karke reuse karti hai, scroll aur filters smooth hain. Punch Time In / Time Out ab default nahi dikhte — Times field on karne par do alag blocks mein aate hain.
releaseNotes: Flashy v2.24: (1) INACTIVE employees HR Dashboard aur Flashy ke counts/lists se hat gaye — Dashboard Total Workforce ab 150 ki bajaye 92, Flashy header count, division/department filters aur department report bhi Active-only; sirf Employee Directory mein saare 150 dikhte hain. Root cause: Dashboard ka workforce filter status check hi nahi karta tha, aur Flashy ke header stats kul employees par bante the. (2) Attendance Management parity fix — screen render par 'clean' present records ko khud se Absent (aur Sunday par Off Day) bana deti thi; mirrored register records bilkul aisi hi shape ke hain, is liye zyada tar employees Absent nazar aate the halanke salary calculation usi data se sheet ke barabar thi. Ab screen bilkul wahi dikhati hai jo record mein hai — Anas Nadeem ab 0 Present/27 Absent ki bajaye 27 Present/4 Leave. (3) Performance — month ka dataset ek dafa compute hokar memoized rehta hai; har cell ke record scans khatam, filters/tabs/scroll usi loaded data par chalte hain. (4) Times field — punch Time In/Time Out default band; Times on karne par har din ke do alag blocks (Time In, Time Out) aate hain. Verification: node harness asal live data par 33/33 PASS (purana model asal screen ki 0P/27A ghalti bilkul reproduce karta hai, naya model teeno sample employees par stored record ke barabar); web chunks live hash-verified; APK badging versionCode 34 / 2.24, signer purana wala.
